author: Gravicode Studios (Kang Fadhil)
name: Medical.Net FHIR API Server
description: ASP.NET Core FHIR R4 server (CRUD, search with _include/_revinclude, _history, transactions, $validate, $everything) with clinical JSON API and HL7 MLLP listener, optional SMART on FHIR (--smart) and durable EF Core storage (--persist), seeded with synthetic patients. Made by Gravicode Studios, led by Kang Fadhil.

smart.description: Protect the FHIR API with SMART on FHIR (authorization code + PKCE, client credentials).

persist.description: Store FHIR resources durably (EF Core, SQLite by default) instead of in memory.
